description:
Parse optional `completion_nudge` from agent prompt frontmatter. Role remains an open string (data-driven agent name).

## Background

`packages/pi-minions/src/agents.ts` already parses name, description, tools, model, thinking, steps, timeout, body-as-systemPrompt. Add one optional string. It is **best-effort** fallback only when no taskType is present, and only for settled/failed.

Unknown roles stay valid. Missing nudge is valid.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/agents.ts`
- `packages/pi-minions/src/types.ts` AgentConfig field (coordinate with the types issue if it already added `completionNudge?: string`; if not, add it here only on AgentConfig)

## Technical approach

Read `frontmatter.completion_nudge` as a trimmed string; ignore empty. Size-bound it (implementation may pick a modest char cap, e.g. 500) so a project role cannot dump a novel into the parent packet.

## Success criteria

- Agent with completion_nudge in YAML exposes it on AgentConfig.
- Agent without it still loads.
- Spawn `agent` still resolves the same files; orchestrate `role` uses the same loader.

## Test plan

- Unit: parse fixture markdown with and without the field.
- Unit: empty/whitespace treated as absent.

## Considerations

Do not treat completion_nudge as a workflow contract. Do not let it override taskType (that's the nudges module). This file (agents.ts) should not grow group/packet logic.
title: Parse optional role completion_nudge from agent frontmatter
